text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle overcomes the poor<n>track conditions
with sheer strength!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Having successfully fired up the<n>crowd with a
powerful performance,<n>Taiki radiates pure
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The next race she sets her sights on<n>is a little short
of a mile.

Hoping to make a good impression on<n>the
spectators, she chooses to run in<n>the Sprinters
Stakes!
